_doc: SLOT CADENCE ROSTER — ONE SOURCE OF TRUTH (work order W3, 2026-08-28). Every accountability consumer reads a component's cadence from HERE and never hardcodes 'daily'. The class this ends: a component moved to weekly, and every checker that assumed daily started reporting it dead — so the alarms became noise on exactly the days they should have been trusted.

_fields.dow: for weekly: the day it runs (0=Sun … 6=Sat)
_fields.source: measured = derived from the boards · declared = stated by the owner and not yet observable here
_fields.falsifier: what would prove this entry wrong. An entry with no falsifier is a belief, not a record.

daily-improvement.evidence: Ran EVERY day 08-01 → 08-26 (n=26). Last board line 2026-08-26; SILENT 08-27 and 08-28 while system-update and pipeline-health-check kept running daily through 08-28. Two silent days is consistent with the 08-26 cadence order moving it to weekly, and equally consistent with it having died on 08-26 — the boards cannot tell those apart, and this session cannot read the app scheduler. 🔴 CONTESTED 2026-08-28: the 07:06 ET pipeline-health-check, with fuller evidence than this roster had, concludes the loop is DEAD — not weekly. Its receipts: daily-briefs/2026-08-27-improvements.md and -08-28-improvements.md both ABSENT (last is 08-26); zero daily-improvement status lines on either board, each apparent grep hit checked by hand and found to be a substring collision inside another task's prose; last ledger row IMP-228 dated 08-26; three Critical 08-27 mandates with no row in any state.
daily-improvement.falsifier: 🔴 RESOLVES SATURDAY 2026-08-29: a board line + grace ⇒ WEEKLY confirmed, set cadence back to weekly/dow 6. No line ⇒ DEAD, and the task must be recreated in the app scheduler. UNTIL THEN THIS ENTRY READS 'daily' ON PURPOSE: an earlier revision recorded 'weekly (declared)' on the strength of a cadence order this session could not verify, and that entry SUPPRESSED the very alarm that should fire for a dead component. A cadence claim that silences an alarm must be measured, never declared — erring toward the alarm is the only safe direction while the question is open.

selection-judge.evidence: Same shape and the same last day: ran daily 08-16 → 08-26 (n=11), silent 08-27 and 08-28. accountability-cycle-weekly.evidence: 2026-08-02, 08-09, 08-16, 08-23 — four consecutive Sundays, no other day.
accountability-cycle-weekly.falsifier: a line on a non-Sunday, or a missed Sunday.

source-health-check-monthly.evidence: one canary in the whole archive (n=1); no observable schedule.
source-health-check-monthly.falsifier: a second line, which would make a cadence derivable.

_default.evidence: every other rostered slot canaries every day in the archive.
_default.falsifier: two consecutive silent days for a task carrying no explicit entry here.

_contested_note: A 'contested' source means two readings disagree and the entry is set to whichever one KEEPS THE ALARM ON until an observation settles it.
